The '''Elf Blade''' is a [[Weapons#Dagger|dagger weapon]] that can be purchased for {{Price|750}} from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after reaching floor 20 in [[The Mines]]. It is a possible reward for the chest on floor 20 of the Mines if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Previously unobtainable weapon introduced. Level lowered from 3 to 2 and sell price lowered from {{Price|150}} to {{Price|100}}.}}
{{History|1.6.9|Added to [[Adventurer's Guild]] shop inventory.}}
